content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi PTS-III Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi PTS-III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the AIIMS Delhi PTS-III Recruitment 2026 is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the PTS-III post in the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in science or relevant subjects from a recognized university, or a Master's degree in the relevant subject to be eligible for the PTS-III post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the PTS-III post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the PTS-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the PTS-III position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 36,400.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the AIIMS Delhi PTS-III Recruitment 2026 is to be submitted via email. Make sure to follow the instructions for sending your application.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the PTS-III recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PTS-III posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PTS-III posts will involve shortlisting of candidates, followed by an interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The AIIMS Delhi PTS-III Recruitment 2026 is for contractual positions. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis.
